hebrewText: וְ/כֶ֥סֶף מִשְׁנֶ֖ה קְח֣וּ בְ/יֶדְ/כֶ֑ם וְ/אֶת הַ/כֶּ֜סֶף הַ/מּוּשָׁ֨ב בְּ/פִ֤י אַמְתְּחֹֽתֵי/כֶם֙ תָּשִׁ֣יבוּ בְ/יֶדְ/כֶ֔ם אוּלַ֥י מִשְׁגֶּ֖ה הֽוּא

tokens.bdb: silver (from its pale color); by implication, money
properly, a repetition, i.e. a duplicate (copy of a document), or a double (in amount); by implication, a second (in order, rank, age, quality or location)
tokens.kjv: college, copy, double, fatlings, next, second (order), twice as much.

tokens.kjv: accept, bring, buy, carry away, drawn, fetch, get, infold, [idiom] many, mingle, place, receive(-ing), reserve, seize, send for, take (away, -ing, up), use, win.
